name: utils
description: Small helpers for working with Claude Code — start a new background Claude Code session with Remote Control in the same repository and get its link, to continue from a phone or the web. Also a one-by-one pass over review findings that closes every decision before the final report. Also shares a claude.ai artifact with named people through the user's own Chrome, private, at Commenter by default. Also a self-review of an output just written (code, spec, plan, handoff), in the same context, before anyone acts on it. Also a local review page where the owner comments on two or more visible items section by section, also from a phone, and the comments come back as next steps.
